Messages.Body:
If I play anathema in a vampire with 0 blood and then rush it, will it
burn in the beginning of the combat, or do I have to inflict at least
1 damage?

Tks.

Messages.Author: FVicentini
Messages.Body:


Anathema requires an actual reduction in blood

good day

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Which means even if you inflict 1 damage on the empty vampire, the Anathema
still won't care. Starting with 0 makes a reduction impossible. The target would
have to gain one (or more) blood first
